test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Consider the following two statements, labeled Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Evaluate them and choose the appropriate answer from the given options.

Assertion (A): India's participation in the Asian Winter Games 2025 will be unique, as it will be the first time the government has provided full financial support.

Reason (R): The government's objective is to enhance India's presence and performance in winter sports by ensuring fair and meritocratic athlete selection.

options.text: A is true, but R is false.
A is false, but R is true.
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **India's participation in the Asian Winter Games 2025** is set to be unique due to full financial support provided by the government for the first time.
 
• The government aims to **promote winter sports** in India by enhancing infrastructure, training, and resources for athletes.
 
• The initiative focuses on **fair and meritocratic athlete selection** to ensure representation based on talent and performance.
 
• This financial backing is part of a broader strategy to **bolster India's global sports presence** and improve performance in niche sporting events.
 
• The decision aligns with India’s vision of becoming a **competitive force in winter sports**, which traditionally have limited participation from the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Asian Winter Games:**

 
 
• A multi-sport event dedicated to winter sports, organized by the Olympic Council of Asia (OCA).
 
• It includes sports like skiing, snowboarding, ice hockey, and figure skating.
 
• The 2029 edition will be held in Saudi Arabia at the futuristic NEOM city, marking its debut in the Middle East.
 
 
 
• **Government Support for Sports in India:**
 
 
• India has increased investments in sports through schemes like Khelo India and Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS).
 
• Emphasis is placed on nurturing talent in non-conventional sports, including winter sports.
 
 
 
• **Winter Sports in India:**
 
 
• India has natural terrains suited for winter sports, such as Gulmarg (Jammu & Kashmir) and Auli (Uttarakhand).
 
• Despite the potential, participation has been historically low due to lack of infrastructure and funding.
 
 
 
• **NEOM City:**
 
 
• A planned futuristic city in Saudi Arabia, designed to integrate smart technology and sustainable development.
 
• NEOM is set to host the 2029 Asian Winter Games, leveraging artificial snow and advanced infrastructure.
